messages.author: 67eefb0e32c64fae
messages.subject: Missing Values in AIC Models
parts:
Hi there!

I am running into an error regarding missing values when I try and run my AIC analysis. I have looked at ?FitList and it mentions that "the response matrix must be identical among fitted models after missing values have been removed. This means that if a response value was removed in one model due to missingness, it needs to be removed from all models".

Some of my models have had missing values removed automatically by R. So I assume I need to also remove these observations from my other models. 

How do I go about doing this? Is there a function that will selectively remove or ignore specific observations or NA values?

Code Below:

#Organize Models into an object for Model Selection
fms <- fitList(m1=fmNull,m2=fm2,m3=fm3,m4=fm4,m5=fm5,m6=fm6,m7=fm7,m8=fm8,m9=fm9,m10=fm10,m11=fm11,m12=fm12,m13=fm13,m14=fm14,m15=fm15,m16=fm16,m17=fm17,m18=fm18,m19=fm19)

# Model Selection using AIC
ModSel <- modSel(fms)

Error in validityMethod(object) : 
  Data are not the same among models due to missing covariate values. Consider removing NAs before analysis.
In addition: Warning messages:
1: Some observations have been discarded because correspoding covariates were missing. 

Thank you for your help :)

Sean

messages.author: 67eefb0e32c64fae
messages.subject: Re: Missing Values in AIC Models
parts:
Solution: I manually went through the process of replacing missing values with an average of the average for the site and the average for the visit number. 

This is similar to what the impute.missing function does, but when I tried that function, it replaced ALL my missing values, even ones that delineated differing numbers of site visits.

Sean
